title: Map TokenExpiredError in the HTTP error mapper
rationale: The domain already distinguishes expiry; the HTTP boundary simply lacks a mapping for it.
tradeoffs: Every route gains the mapping, which is the documented contract
implementationBrief: Add a TokenExpiredError branch to toErrorResponse returning 401 { error: "token_expired" }.

title: Treat any refresh failure as unauthorized
rationale: Clients only need to know they must log in again when refresh fails.
tradeoffs: Collapses distinct failure modes into one status
implementationBrief: Wrap the refresh route in a try/catch that returns 401 { error: "invalid_token" } for any thrown error.

title: Handle expiry explicitly in the refresh route
rationale: Expiry is only meaningful for the refresh flow; keep the global mapper untouched.
tradeoffs: Other routes that surface expiry would need their own handling
implementationBrief: Catch TokenExpiredError around auth.refresh in the refresh route and return 401 { error: "token_expired" }; rethrow anything else.
